text: some very dubious adverts have started appearing, one for something called Blush, not child friendly with open nudity in it, if it's not that then it's a 90 second advert just had one of those before the level and one to gain the double points at the end. 3 minutes of adverts after a 30 second level is taking the piss. Developers also have a very sneaky buy power ups button right after you fail a level that you automatically press. Luckily I have protected purchases otherwise I'd be £5.49 down.

It's a simple game that's good enough to while away time but the ads take longer to run than each level takes to complete. At about level 57 you are forced to install another to keep playing. This was called Color Block Run and was a completely different game. I force closed the game and was able to continue playing. I deleted the "new" game once I realised it wasn't a continuation.

I love the game, however the ads are killing me - I know that this game is trying to monetise the best way it can, but an ad after every level, even when i clicked to not get extra money is extremely tiring. If the ads were after maybe 4 levels, I would give a much higher rating. The number of ads are making me lose interest in the game

It's generally fun, but it punishes you hard for not being able to tell the difference between two incredibly similar shades of colour. If you're colour blind then you have no hope. EDIT: Currently completely stuck on a level that is impossible. Have no free boosts and am unwilling to spend any more money on buying new ones. Very disappointing.

Very addictive game, I'm level 1340 and am stuck unless I pay to win (which I have done already in earlier levels). The totems are not great, you can get close to winning then be blocked by totems and have to pay to continue with no guarantee there won't be another totem that blocks you! Doubt I'll continue playing tbh, shame as I'd paid £8.99 to remove ads by level 500

The game has potential, however, it is very clear the puzzles are designed for you to lose multiple times unless you use the power ups. Obviously, they want you to spend your money, because the ads they force on you aren't bringing them enough revenue. I remember when games were made to be fun and entertaining, now they are only a money grabber. I would give this game 5 stars if they changed the way the puzzles are designed for you to lose.

So many LONG ads. I get you have to monetise with ads, but do they have to be so long and so repetitive. if I see another testerup ad I'm going to fill our wheelie bin with water and go dive in head first. it's quicker to quit the app and log back in.... you would think.... but they've got around that trick as well. honestly, it's not worth paying for and its not really worth sitting through so many long ads. shame because it's quite addictive.

Many levels are impossible without using power ups, if you're out of coins you then have to pay for more else you're effectively locked out of progressing. In my experience the game started lagging very hard when I got over a thousand levels in which causes the pigs to miss blocks out, making levels even harder, this is not down to my phone as every other app runs perfectly and my phone is less than a year old. Do not install this game, incredibly scummy practices in use

game seemed okay. 20 minutes in you get adds after every level.. really intrusive adds that you can't get out of.. you have to close the app, start it again, to get hit by another intrusive inescapable add!!! have adds in games really got this bad.. 30 second adds, maybe even 1 minute adds, might have been okay! but this is crazy!!! do not install if you enjoy your sanity ;)

It's fun and actually challenging but the animation for loading and unloading the shooters from the five spots you get is so slow that it will CONSTANTLY say you've run out of room and you lose the level when really, if the loading and unloading was faster, you wouldn't have run out of space, which is incredibly frustrating. Part of the fun is juggling the shooters in and out of the loading spaces, so clicking like mad only to have it fail you for the eighth time when you should be fine sucks.

this is the slowest game I have ever played. It took 6 minutes to load. The pigs went round the track in jumps with long waits between each jump. Most of the pigs jumped round the track without knocking out any squares at all. The game was so slow that the screen blacked out on several occasions because nothing was happening. Don't bother trying this game.

I'd love to give this a 5 but due to the money grabbing side and not able to get by some levels without paying again its a let down ! Paid to remove adverts, you only get 40 coins a time for completing a level. As the levels get harder you have literally zero chance of completion unless you spend money again. I bought the campaign pass and lost over 10 rewards! I won't be spending another penny. ! you need 900 coins then 1800 if you get stuck ! stuck at level 499 with zero further progress.

I like the actual game but a few things about this app really annoy me. Mainly that if you need to exit during a level it doesn't save your progress and you lose a life/streak. I've also had it glitch a few times after an advert and do the same thing. Occasionally you hit a level which is nigh on impossible to pass without using extras. Like that there are no ads in the middle of levels like some games but I'm uninstalling due to the negatives I've mentioned.

amusing so far. first forced ad appears after level 19, and then after every single level. even if you press "continue" instead of choosing to watch an ad for double rewards, you just get to watch one for nothing instead. it's faster to kill the app and reopen it between every level. awful ad policy. Devs, why ruin it like this?

I'm on level 1080 at the time I'm writing this review so I feel I know the game quite well. You have to be extremely patient and try many times before you succeed and pass a level. It is considered a pay to play game. The truth is....it is. That's not fair. The absolute worst thing is, it is programmed to cheat during levels. It will finish the game while you still have time to clear your board. This is where the pay to play comes in and I'd like to question the legality.

I really enjoy this game but unfortunately I have to give it a negative review ATM as it's frustrating and almost unplayable. the game is now constantly crashing or freezing, meaning that whenever I'm doing lava quest I end up failing it because the app is constantly restarting. this is incredibly frustrating when I continue to invest my coins in it in order to get through the levels and then have wasted them through no fault of my own.

Great game until you get to a level that is impossible to win. In my case this is level 299. I've used up all my free helps and I refuse to pay for more. So, I either continue to try to beat the level until the day I die or I delete the game. I'll probably choose the latter! It's a shame as otherwise it's an enjoyable game.

level 685 is impossible unless you have poweups. It's a great game but levels like this need either more lives, an option to watch an ad for powerups, or a simplify option after so many attempts at it. I've already spent money on this game and refuse to spend more when you're making levels far too difficult, practically forcing people to buy coins. Also, please make the game have cloud saving so it can be played on multiple devices. I don't understand why you don't already.

I would have given it a four if it weren't obvious that the game is trying to force you to pay money. certain levels are literally impossible to beat unless you pay to go out of order. I paid for add free and paid over 600 levels before I got so pissed off spending over 5 minutes over and over again on one level only to be screwed over by color order. Incredibly disappointed, wish I could get a refund.

Decently fun game. I like the difficulty but I didn't like the increasing complexity, I got tired of it after about 300 levels. There are ads after every single level, which is annoying, it doesn't save your progress if you delete/ re-download the app, and it drains my phone battery super fast.

Lots to like! The advert removal works, and is moderately priced. The gameplay is fun and addictive. I do have a wish for more levels though, as they do repeat. Editing this review as the game now has impossible levels that you have to pay to pass. This is since the addition of power ups. It was fun before, and I paid to remove ads as I really enjoyed it. Now I am filled with rage and disappointment. It has been ruined for me.

I paid for ad free - if you're going to play this a lot like I did then it is worth it. Yes, some levels are difficult but you don't need to pay to play as long as you persevere. But I guess too many people complained because now even the "very hard" levels are super easy, like there's no difference between very hard and normal. Surely there's a balance? It's for this reason I'm stopping playing because it becomes less about logic and more about mind numbing play.

Initially, I loved this game. I played over 10 hours. Then I broke my phone and when the game reinstalled on my new phone I had lost all my progress. To call that frustrating is a vast understatement. This is particularly true as I am logged in through the Play account and must have WiFi enabled. I enjoyed the mix of extremely challenging and easier levels, but this is off-putting.

I really wanted to like this game, but the amount of ads was too much for me. Ads after every level completed or not. They are so long and it doesn't matter if you hit the X, it takes you to that ads website. For example, Snapchat or Temu . It takes forever to accumulate coins or rewards and the amount of coins needed to buy rewards is ridiculous. It was a fun addictive game, but I'm deleting it due to the reasons above. It makes it less fun.

what seems like a great game for a while, quickly turns annoying. after the first few levels you'll get an ad after every few games, then after every game. I'm quitting at level 279, which is designed to only be beaten by using power ups. if you haven't got coins saved you'll end up paying cash money to beat an otherwise impossible level - literally pay to win. no thanks, I'm out.

Although this is a really fun game it is borderline pay to play. You can get so far, and gain coins and boosters but these soon run out as the levels get progressively harder. They're all doable eventually but the odd one is ridiculous, and needs a very specific set of moves to complete. Just spent 3 weeks (occasional) play to get past level 749. Its not fun when it gets that frustrating.

if you enjoy playing games, don't play this. The game is enjoyable until around level 500. it's another one of those "play the game exactly right or you will lose. you're so close though, why not just spend some money" games. You can earn coins in game, between 10 and 40 per level. to continue a level you fail costs 900 coins. You get lots of coins if you complete 7 challenges in a row, but there is always a "play the game perfectly to win this level" in the middle of those 7 levels. you get it

I've paid for the removal of ads, no problem there. However what I can't abide is that some levels aren't possible to complete unless power ups / coins are used. Level 413 I did everything correct only to be faced by the entire row behind padlocks but there was no other way of unlocking other than spending coins. To be shepherded to paying or losing is in my opinion shady.

Whilst the gameplay loop is enjoyable, the fact the game tries to stop you playing if you have no phone signal is infuriating. especially as if you click refresh the game will continue for a few seconds each time, so it's clear that an online connection is not necessary for the game to work. There is no need for an always online requirement, and this means use on low signal journeys such as the tube - exactly when a mobile game is most playable - are impossible

I really liked this game, and enjoyed it keeping my brain active. However now I have got stuck and it's forcing me to pay real money which I dislike immensely. There is no way to get around it except to pay real money for the things to help you. No little daily counter that would eventually get your money up so you can buy the items, like other games have. I have ready bought one pack to help, but I won't be buying another, nor will I be playing again.

So it's pretty fun. It's got more function than other games of this type and I like the difficulty overall. This game has a major flaw though! If you are in the middle of a level, leave the app (not close just hop from one app to another) it closes and counts that as a fail. This is a problem for several reasons and is the main reason I stop playing for weeks on end.

2nd Edit. latest update, which claims that bugs are fixed is nonsense! still can't open the damned game. I give up! 7 emails and not 1 single response from them. This was great until this latest update. The game won't load now!! Help Edit. and again! Last time, I reinstalled it and lost all progress. The creators have not responded to anything. Great game, but if it won't load don't expect any replies and prepare to lose all progress if you uninstall.

Level 789 is glitchy as it is dense (small) pixels and it moves "too fast" around the conveyor belt and doesn't hit pixels reliably, so it's actually random what gets hit. There have been one or two before that were maybe like this, but this is the worst. Otherwise, I really enjoy this game, once I blocked ads. Sometimes I get stuck for a while on one level and run out of lives for a while but with persistence eventually pass it. It's been possible to do so far without buying anything.

Well drat. I'm here to eat my words. Level 195-196 (depending on the player I guess) is crazy hard and took me weeks to get past, but I finally did and now I can't stop playing this game! It is challenging but relaxing. There is still the occasional level that takes me days to figure out, but I'm really enjoying it.

Lvl 463 is literally impossible. No matter what method I try it's not possible to get the right amount of colour bricks to progress to the next key. You need power ups which I don't have enough coins for (which are also ridiculously priced) and I'm not paying real money for in game coins. Any level should be solvable without power ups, it's also only rated hard not very hard.

Can be a fun challenging game but the power ups are really stingy. We need to be given more or a daily reward. You also need to have the internet to play which is ridiculous. Was gonna be a 4* but they've halved the reward at the end of a level. Sometimes when I go for the stingy extra reward it will restart the game.

game basically forces you to watch ads and spend in game money to progress. it gives you no chance to finish the puzzle and no time to put on another pig when it's designed to have the entire belt and reserve full. so many times I failed because I think I have time to put one up, but don't. a better design mechanism would be to have them stop on the carousel and ask if you have any more moves before just killing you outright. anyway, uninstalled and on to the next

Fun and relaxing game up until you reach impossible levels. I have been on 949 for about a week. Where if you haven't saved coins your basically forced into a purchase to have even the slightest chance of beating it. also before the recent update the cheapest 300 coin booster would give 3 extra slots to use when you needed, now its only one. soon to be un-installing, as its now just an annoyance.

A little fun, a lot wrong. Ads every single level. Ads every death. Ads on ads. Resource hog (is it loading ads in the background?, probably). Will kill your battery. Difficulty? Better know the future, or you will fail. Not exactly intelligent game design when you make people guess. Faster to reset than watch ads. Don't play if you need your phone later, as this will drain your battery. Once you get past level 100, forget about the level streak mini game and challenges.

Update ruined all the fun. Used to get a power by watching an ad or buying with coins. Now only coins buy powers which are a microtransaction. Enjoyed getting to level 324 until I got stuck on a hard level and spent my coins trying to pass it. Now I can't move on unless I spend a minimum of AU$5.78 to buy just three single use powers. All purchases are overpriced. Buying the ad free version is nearly double my monthly play pass subscription. No thanks, I'm uninstalling.

Game was a tonn of fun until now. Multiple times I have run across levels that are completely impassable without using coins. No daily levels means you also have no way to earn coins once you get stuck. Level 643 was my last straw. I'd be willing to play it even with all the ads if there was a daily mission to do in order to get coins at least. Dont recommend

Really enjoyed this game until I got stuck on a Very Hard level and ran out of coins. I used the solver on their website, but my app didn't reflect what was shown in the video. I would recommend AT LEAST letting you earn coins via ad so you can still earn them even if you can't pass a level. Otherwise I REALLY love this game and played thousands of levels.

I really like this game, but I wish that it didn't speed up at the end. I like how rhythmic and calming it is, and the fast ending ruins that. Maybe there could be an optional button to hit "speed up" once you have all of the cannons out on the track that are left. That way the people who don't want to wait don't have to.

EDIT: There are levels you absolutely cannot win without power ups, which is a failure in my opinion. If after the first and ONLY move available, you get locked out of any moves, you've failed as a game designer.

Games is really fun for a while. Ads-free is very reasonable at $3. Some levels are very difficult or impossible to win, with no way to watch ads to get past. You have to spend gold, which you quickly run out of. Then it tries to get you to purchase "Golden Pass 1" or "Pixel Pass" for ten bucks but it doesn't tell you what you're buying. You have to re-install over and over if you want to keep playing. As others have remarked, DO NOT PLAY if you have one click purchasing. UI is malicious.

Fun game overall. Points of improvement need, failed offer is in a horrible location. Your in the middle of a play and fail your clicking it without knowing it first. Very annoying. The more you play the more ads run. Makes me want to play less not more. Especially if your failing the level less than a minute or two, you end up watching an ad that is triple the time you actually played.

so the game is reasonably fun. but there's functionally no difference between choosing to watch an ad for the bonus gold at the end of a level and proceeding without it, because you have to watch the ad anyway. you also can't watch ads to continue difficult levels or get tools to make it easier, and there are levels you don't seem to be able to do without them, so you have to spend money.

not a bad game, great time killer. theres ads after every level and this can be played offline to an extent. a pop up will show up saying there no internet you refresh it can play for a second and it pops back up. it costs roughly 8 dollars for no ads. "which is roughly the same price as actual games with story linesthe ads vary, sometimes its one ad, sometimes 2. they can be skipped but you still have to wait to click out of the ads.

This game is fun but has a genuinely malicious UI designed to make you buy something the instant you lose, so DO NOT PLAY if you have one-click purchasing on. Some levels are impossible to beat without powerups. Got stuck on lvl 349 for several days before I finally gave up, went to uninstall and updated to see if it changed, and lo and behold, its a different level now. 🙄 Thanks I guess.

EDIT after dev response: NOT true. Locked behind paywall is real. I am stuck on a level and only way to progress is to buy coins. I liked the game and wanted to give it much better score but it is hard locked with pay wall at some point. 99% of similar games allow you to get help or coins with ads ao that you can continue if you get stuck. Here you must pay at some point.

decent game, however the ads can be absolutely annoying at times. Every 2 completed levels triggers an ad break which is fine although quite annoying at times. However if you fail a level you immediately get an ad. This becomes annoying as you can see an ad for completing 2 levels and then fail the third level and get kicked back into a 40 second ad. if the ads were consistent like every 3 levels then fine. But when you see the same ad for the same game twice in 3 minutes its just bad design.

Soft paywall forces you to spend money. Don't bother paying to remove ads as they make you spend more on microtransactions later with levels that require you to spend in game currency. You can get stuck easily because in game currency is earned once for clearing a level. If you're unable to clear levels you'll be stuck with the limited amount you have.

Great game but im stuck on level 189. The colours dont come round quick enough, I've not got enough coins to buy one of the power ups. I refuse to spend real money. Please have at least a daily log in for 50 coins or something. Or at least give you your power up back when you fail. It's impossible now. Been stuck on it for 2 days and still cant progress.

Loved the game, kept me wanting to play more. Some levels are harder, some really easy. Didn't need to spend any coins or real money to make it through any level. Unfortunately, around level 100-110, the levels start to repeat, losing the fun of the game.

game is ok, clearly designed to make it almost impossible to play without spending money. once a level is complete, it gives you the option to watch an ad for double coins. You'd think that if i didn't choose that option, i wouldn't have to watch an ad. nope. every single time you complete a level; advertisement. it has become very annoying after only 25 levels of play. will be uninstalling after getting my fetch rewards

So addictive and love the pixel art!! Some levels can be very difficult but I keep trying to persevere. Super fun and found it worth it to pay to ditch the ads. It's been a while since I got hooked on a mobile game. Thank you! Only thing I wish is that when you pause the game, it doesn't reset the game after a while. That is seriously frustrating!!

I'm addicted to this game! Once I figured I could have up to 10 piggies in play, I was able to beat levels. The ads are EXTREMELY annoying which is why I didn't give it 5 stars. I don't mind ads but after EVERY game whether you beat it or not...and some of them are THREE minutes long! Now I just close the game out and restart. I may pay to go ad free but I'm only on level 490...we'll see if I stay with it. I like how it sounds like fireworks as you remove pixels

Let me start off by saying the game itself is fun. Then you get ads. I'm not opposed to ads to support developers but there are too many ads in this game. Lose a life, ad. Win a level, ad. Not every five levels. I'm talking every level. It's mildly funny to me that when you finish a level they offer ad to boost your coins. You should just do it every time because you're getting an ad regardless.

The game itself is fun. You have to play some of the levels many times to pass. I am at level 524 and have been on it for 2 weeks. I believe I am ready to uninstall as you have to watch ads (sometimes multiple) after every level win or loose. This game doesn't give you coins or power-ups ever unless you pass a level. I figure they are making money off of all of the ads and I am not going to pay for something just to turn around and have to pay again. It's too bad.

I enjoyed this game. However you cannot exit the ads. You have to click on them. Then close whatever it opens. then go back to the game to try and proceed. I have been stuck at level 39. I have completed it three times. then the ad pops up. after it runs its course it doesn't give me an option to close it. It just brings me to another app to install. I reload the game. I lost the progress of beating level 39. So unfortunately I am uninstalling this game.

If you boot the game a second time you get an ad every level clear and it stays like that for the rest of your life. And there is a way to get x2 reward bonus by watching an ad. So you would have to watch an ad after an ad if you want that. To sum it up: This game is a cashgrab and I bet that 95.2% percent of devs working on this are either AI or into NFTs. so do them a favor and just right click their property then "Save image as..."

Great game, but if it crashes or you dont open the game up after awhile it closes and you lose your streak for certain challenges. Its a real punch in the gut after you've payed to stay in a Very Hard level. To be honest, I feels like they are stealing from you. Let me watch the awfully long ads instead. Very disappointed in this game at the higher levels.

Too many ads & no offline option. An ad after literally every single level is WAY too much. And the fact they block the game so you can't play offline just so you can't skip the ads, is just gross. It's a cute game and I'd enjoy it a lot if I didn't have to force close after every single play to avoid seeing the same 3 minute ad every time I complete a level. You're not going to force me to spend $8 just to not be annoyed. I'd much rather uninstall than be bullied, despite enjoying the game.

I Love hard puzzle games. We're supposed to be able to watch an ad to double my winning or get a free live. That function NEVER has worked. always says unavailable. Not sure why its an option. Sometimes I buy lives/boosters. why should I have to, if this is supposedly an option/perk of the game. I stopped buying boosters & will play only when given lives. Also some levels once you beat them, if you stop play after completing they make you play over. its always the really hard 1s. thats not fair

Ads. This is actually a fun game, I'd honestly give it 4 maybe 5 stars. I get devs need to get paid, but the ads are beyond ridiculous in this game. After everything, there is an ad. Beat a level, ad, lose a level ad, I've even watched an elective ad, and gotten an intrusive ad. Devs, this actually hurts your game, because I'm close to uninstalling due to the frequency of ads and I'm sure others will too. No one playing, means no ads to line your pockets. I'm not paying for ad free out of spite.

This is actually one of my favorite fast paste puzzle games and I can't tell you how many I've downloaded and tried out. the mechanics and graphics are good eye- catchy. you get a good 40 coins a level but can watch an ad and get extra 40 more coins which takes a minute to accumulate enough to buy rewards but the side races gives opportunities to win a a good amount of rewards as in coins and special moves. only thing I dont like is having to go thru an ad after every level. That's to much!!

Love the game but there is a glitch in the game that makes it close. For the 5th time that I paid the 5.99 to save myself, the game shut down right after the purchase causing me to water my money. If it happened once I could get over that but now it's EVERYTIME I make a purchase to save my game, it shuts down causing me to die. Make this right and I'll give 5 stars. If not, I'm uninstalling.

Love it. I don't understand the comments about it being too hard and having to use power ups, I'm on level 740 and haven't had to use power ups, sometimes it takes me quite a few lives to get through a level but I get there in the end. Game lost one star because it's a bit buggy and will skip over pixels not grabbing them all

First off, I appreciate that the ads for this game (at least the ones I saw) didn't do that cringy psychological tactic of showing someone playing like they're blind/drunk, and asking "Can YoU do BetTER???" The game itself is fun enough. I'm 500 levels in, haven't spent any real money yet, and the game never feels to me like it uses unfair difficulty to drain your items faster than you can earn them for free.

I understand needing to play ads, but if you give us an option at the end of a level to watch an ad for extra reward, and then we say no... you shouldn't play an ad anyway. That just feels ingenuous. On top of that the ads are too frequent. Win or lose there is an ad at the end of every single play. It's too much.

edit: The option to resume levels has been added!! 5 star game now to me.-----I'm really enjoying the game, I'm at about level 600 right now. my biggest gripe is that it doesn't save your progress if you start a level and have to do something else. so I could be 95% of the way through a level but if I have to switch tabs and do something else real quick it will exit out and I lose my progress. my fire quest, and any coins I might have spent. so please make an option to resume levels

The new events they keep adding are awful. There's no creativity to make them fun (all about speeding through levels when I want to relax and enjoy the art) and NO rewards for anything under first place. Now they are adding 1 hour long races and at the end if you don't get first place you get NOTHING for an HOUR of playing. And you can't opt out of a race until it's over so if you see yourself falling behind it's not even worth it to keep playing. Tempted to quit. 🙄

My phone broke and I had to get a new one. despite being signed in on my old phone it deleted all my progress and purchases in this app. Support has done absolutely nothing for me other than "make sure you're signed in" and "the no ads purchase removes the forced ads but not rewarded ads." Both of which are not my problem. I sent them receipts and screenshots of the no ads bundle on my game and they still do nothing. After a while the levels repeat and you have to use powerups to beat them.

It's a fun game at first. But like all free games of this caliber, after a certain point you're pretty much beaten into submission one way or another: either you buy into the game, or you don't. Like other reviews have said, there are ads after every level which is absolutely absurd, and if you want to get rid of the ads it's $8 which also offers playing without internet. I enjoyed what I played but once I got locked to the same level for 3 days, I've uninstalled the game. Good riddance.

It's a fine time-waster game. Eventually you will reach a point (in the mid-200s level-wise) where the levels are impossible to complete without multiple power-ups. I wish all levels were solveable, and I wish it were just the game itself without all the extra nonsense (challenges, battle pass, etc. a puzzle game does not need all this stuff.)

Seems incredibly fun at first, becomes just random nonsense with UI choices deliberately shifting depending on contract to get you spending coins in muscle memory. After about level 2000, it becomes more chance than skill. By 3200, it's pointless. Levels marked as easy can be grindingly difficult. it's too bad because it starts off really fun and I would've reset and played again, but not now. Very disappointing.

I'm playing on a Windows 11 laptop. The last 3 days the game has been crashing frequently. In order to get it to work again the first time it happened I had to completely delete it, losing all my progress. I'm atill aving to uninstall and reinstall from the app. Fortunately, I haven't lost my current progress. If this keeps up I'm going to find a new game.

Levels get extremely difficult early in the game (level 35). I've been stuck on this nearly impossible level for days now. I'm sure it's passable, with some lucky choosing of unneeded colors. This doesn't qualify as challenging for me, just beyond frustrating. Not fun and not the way I want to spend my free time. I do like that there's no timer for the levels. Could be a fun time waster...if you like beating your head against the wall.

I paid for no ads which was nice. The game is fun and addictive. Until I got a little farther in levels. By level 586 there's no skill needed, just money. I can't get past this level with the boosters I've reserved and the colors NEEDED to unlock the other colors I NEED are under lock and key and keeps locking me out. There's no way to unlock them without spending money. So it's time to uninstall. The game developers shouldn't make the game free in the first place if all they want is money!

Really liked this game for a long time and I'm sad to give such a low review. I'm on level 737 and finally cracked and decided to buy some coins because I've made about 25 attempts and used most of my items even though it's a normal level. The app took my money and Google Play store knows it went through, but it won't reflect in-game. Support has not responded to my tickets, so I'm stuck and will be uninstalling. I'd recommend the game, but discourage any purchases.

The game is decent for about 100 levels. The levels are doable. They give you some helper objects. I'm up to level 144 and the difficulty goes up. I don't think you can continue to progress without paying money. The economy of the game is deceiving. You'll build up coins initially and use those for the helpers. But you run out and you'll be 'encouraged' to spend real money. Don't do it. You'll get annoyed with the ads after every round.

There are ads after every level, with them being very intrusive. Most of the ads require opening up the App Store to actually close the ad. In some of these ads with the store redirect, it causes the app to reload when trying to resume the game. It can be offline if you pay for it, so as of today when it lists offline it should come with an asterisk. Otherwise it can be an enjoyable game.

Like all of the rest... It's just like all of the games these days where you can't continue playing without purchasing. Forced ad spam after every level, makes the game very boring, only way to clear is close the game and restart. some ads would be fine, but this is purely a cash grab..

I love this game. It's super fun and I don't really mind the ads all that much. That being said, ever since the update, I haven't been able to play it. It's just stuck on the loading screen. I don't want to uninstall it and reinstall it because I'm afraid I'll lose all my progress.
This is a very exciting game it really helps with my anxiety as well.

game was fun for a while, there were quite a few levels/images that were repetitive, but once I got past that it seemed like there was even more challenging levels which was great... until you realize that there are certain levels that cannot be beaten without the extra power ups, and there is no mechanism by which a player can gain daily rewards or gain additional power ups by watching an ad, so the only means by which to continue leveling up is by purchasing a bundle or coins from the shop.

I really like this game, it's challenging but still simple. Another reviewer mentioned the purchase button pops up as you lose just where you are clicking and is exactly what happens. Also there comes a point where you can't play or advance unless you purchase upgrades or whatever. I just wanted a fun little game and I did enjoy it. I made it thru 70 or so levels, but I'm uninstalling it. Greedy app maker.
This game starts with no ad pop-ups. While playing the game "ad break" pop-up. Those ad pop-ups make playing this game annoying. I only want to play the game not watch ad's.

Used to love this game until they changed it so that you have to spend money to beat the super hard levels. I get that I'm in the 400s, but come on! I had some shuffles built up so I tried to use them, but they literally do nothing. I clicked on 5 of them in a row during a particularly difficult level and not a single thing happened. if you're going to include power ups in your game, at least make sure they do something! I have no choice but to uninstall unfortunately

Steals your money. When you lose a level, the "fail purchase" bundle is in the exact placement where you click to send the pigs into the playing field, so you easily accidentally click the purchase and accept before you even realize you've lost the level and there is no way to cancel the purchase. I have done this three times at $6 per mistake. These developers know exactly what they did by building the game this way.

Awesome and original but repetitive levels... It is a shame, because it cuts all the fun. That is why I set 3 stars for now. We need at least 1000 levels! Lmao - yeah I am sure it's a lot of work... But for this kind of games that is what we usually have. I don't recommend to pay for no ads, it's not worth it if you play the same levels all over again.

I would love it, if it weren't a blatant cash grab. It forces ads but won't let me watch any for rewards. A lot of these levels are quite literally impossible. Once they added the wood and ice it ruined it. I'll have three ice blocks and four blocks in the que that aren't any colors I need. The shuffle option doesn't work half of the time. Also, there's no reason for it to need a connection. There is no online interaction. It's obviously that way so that we're forced to watch the ads.

It's a fun time killer game and challenging. The downside is you can accidentally make a purchase when the try again button shows up on top of the purchase button and if you're not careful when you hit the try again button, you hit the make purchase button below. Due to this issue, I will be uninstalling this game even though I had enjoyed playing this game, and hopefully, I can get reimbursed.

Fun game that almost requires you to pay. Been enjoying this a lot. But once you get to a level that is more or less impossible to beat without power ups, you're screwed. there's no way to earn coins, and no way to get help. I've been doing well for many levels, but am suddenly stuck and no way to get past. couple that with the need to been online to play, and ads after everything you do, this is unfortunately an uninstall.

I actually like the game. There is an Ad after every round, with the exception of the first 20 or 25 rounds. What I dislike about the hammer is what gives it 1 star... when you lose a round, a button pops up to pay for an in-app purchase. they place it right where you are tapping, this you are half way through sending them real money. There is no way this is a mistake. if you have one click purchases set up, I imagine that you would inadvertently purchase something each time you lose. Not cool.

A fun game, but some very hard levels really can't be beaten without a power up. I've tried some levels quite a few times. On the plus side, you can save up enough coins to buy power ups in between very hard levels. Maybe give more coins if you win a (very) hard level? Also, no in level ads. However, if you fail a level, the pay for fail bonus is right on the screen where you're tapping, so if you're not paying attention and you have auto pay enabled, this can be a problem.

The game play is extremely fun and is easily five stars. What gives me cause for concern is how, as you are frantically tapping to get your pigs out of the launch bay, if you lose it's incredibly easy to inadvertently purchase a gift pack for almost $10 Canadian. I've just inadvertently done that for the first time, and I can see how easy it would be for someone else to do that. I hope that's not a deliberate UI choice.

Good little game. Smooth gameplay. I didn't mind the ads after a couple of levels, but when it got to one ad after every level - I'm out. the levels are not hard and they don't take much time, I felt like more time was spent watching ads. I get it, we all need to get paid.... but there needs to be balance. Five stars for the game alone, one star for all the ads as you level up.
It was fun, but by level 660, you cannot beat the level without using power ups. I'm uninstalling the game because there's no reason to play a game that you have to pay to win.

good fun game but level 16 is broken telling me that a piggy has leftover ammo and to use it again but it's a paired one and its partner isn't back in the magazine yet so it can't be played so I'm stuck.

The game itself is fun, I don't mind level repeats. However, if you get a hard level and can't get by it without upgrades, but don't have the coins to buy upgrades, you get stuck on one level for a long time. The one ad after every level would be okay for me(let's face it, there's worse) if not for the fact that every ad that I get can't be closed out of(no X appears) and I have to close and reopen the app after every level.

its a fun game to start off with, after 20 rounds the adverts start after ever round completion, this is annoying, and has resulted in my deleting the game, could have been 5 stars if the adverts weren't so forced

Game is really fun, addictive. However, multiple times now has it glitched and frozen and never opened again no matter what I do, forcing me to reinstall it and lose all progress. Plus, they put the buy offers when you lose right where you're tapping your finger, so it tries to buy something pretty much every time. Gets annoying after a while.

Pay to play if you get stuck. I love the concept of this game. However, after 130+ levels, I'm stuck on a "very hard" level. The only way that I can progress is if I spend money for the boosts. There is no way to earn coins or a boost. I would happily watch an ad in order to earn boosts or to swipe away the full tray and give me space to continue. I'll end up uninstalling the game if I can't figure out how to pass this level soon.

I love this game but it has one serious flaw. When you lose a level, the button to buy a bonus pack is right where the button to shoot pixels is, so it is very easy to accidentally "purchase" a bonus pack without meaning to. I'm just about ready to delete the game now, since I've ended up buying 2 or 3 things I never wanted just because the game is poorly designed.

Overall entertaining, not very many unique levels. The ads were pretty much every level, so I paid for ad-free. There were maybe around 250-300 unique levels, with each level taking maybe 3-5 minutes to play. I enjoy this game enough that I wish there were more unique levels. I am currently on level 400-something and recognizing all of the pictures. Edit: More levels came out in November 2025. I'm happy they're still releasing more.

it would be a great game if it was offline. It's super annoying to go through and have to watch ads after every level. Great, they don't disrupt the levels. How about they don't disrupt the game at all? Also, good luck getting past some levels without any help. 900 coins to continue and you only earn 80 (if you watch an ad) a level. Its a money mongering game

I would love to give higher but I've been locked out of the game for over a week (frozen on loading title page). I also reached out to support more than 2 business days ago - no autoreply or acknowledgement of my email. The purchase buttons also need to be repositioned. More than once per day when I fail a level, the UI responds as if I've hit the purchase button to continue the level. I never do and therefore then get payment failed as I navigate away from those payment screens.

It acts like it has no "intrusive ads" and gives you basically no ads until level 10. Then after that it says you can pay $8 for no ads and playing offline. If you choose not to, you start to get an ad after almost every level. It's not unbearable, but it feels very intentional. (Especially since offline play is behind a paywall, meaning you can't go into airplane mode to avoid ads.) Outside of that, the game is fun but gets very same-y after 20 levels or so. Not bad, though. Very decent.

At first it was great. I liked that it rotated between easy, hard, and extra hard levels. Then the levels started repeating. I kept playing the same levels over and over which was boring. The final straw was level 429. There is no way to pass it based on where the outside colors are. I don't have enough coins for the boost and there is no way to earn power ups unless you spend real money. It needs a daily spin or watch ads for power ups.

I will start off by saying that I love this game. It's fun and I love the strategy aspect. It's casual but still requires thinking - which is always nice in my opinion! For anyone who is wondering: Ad-free in the beginning but before you hit level 28, it's ads in between every game. Costs $8 to get rid of the ads. I hate games that start off with no ads and then adds an abundance of them once someone is into it.

this was fun for the first 180 levels or so but eventually it got so difficult it stopped being fun. I don't really play games like this for the challenge, I play stuff like this to relax, and if I'm just getting frustrated because I'm stuck on the same stupid level that I can't even win when using a ton of powerups, then I'm done, this isn't relaxing anymore. life is frustrating enough as it is. this game quickly stopped bring fun, so it failed on a basic level. I don't need this.

If you lose, you best have your payment settings in check because the amount of accidental purchases I've done because of the inconvenient placement of popups is ridonk. You will think youre still playing the game, sudden loss, popup pops up while youre still slamming the screen with your finger, and you'll have paid $10 because of the speed it decides to pop up. the pop ups are probably faster than the game itself, especially when lagging. & some levels are impossible to pass without powerups

Ads, Ads, Ads!! Game started off ok. Play 5 or so levels, get an ad. Then it went to every 2-3 levels. Now, there's an ad after each level. Win or lose, there's an ad. It has become quicker to close the app and reopen when the ad starts. I know you there's an option to purchase ad free but it's not within my means at this time. I just want to play a game, not watch ads.

Seems like a decent game, but they want you to pay real money for power ups. It would be nice to be able to watch an ad to get a power up instead of the only option to pay cash, especially in a game that has forced ads to begin with! Please fix this and this game would easily be a four to five star game. As it stands, two stars are being generous.

I like the game itself but I absolutely hate their malicious UI design. they try to trick you into making an in game purchase by having a pop up that appears right where you're playing in an attempt to get you to accidently click it. It also happens so fast that if you have one step payment set up in your Google account, then it's easy to accidently purchase something you don't want (like I just did, hence the review). You also can't play without internet or data which sometimes is the point.

Fun, but at level 95 there seems to be a glitch. A dark blue pixel is not being blocked on one side, but the pixel shooter won't hit it. Maybe the game wants the pixel to be unblocked on 2 sides, which doesn't make sense. I had to redo that level so many times to finally complete it. Please fix it. Looking again, it only happens with pixel shooters that are connected. They don't start for the exact beginning, leaving a small but important section unshootable. Also, level 104+ are repeats.

It's addicting but forced ads are annoying. I got to level 20 before an ad started and then after that it's a forced ad that you have to press an x to get out of the ad about 3 times, plus waiting 20 seconds before you can get back to playing the game. Very annoying. Also, there is a pop-up right where you are clicking when you lose to make you purchase something. Be careful if you have 1 click buy turned on. I thankfully don't, but be careful. Smh you should be ashamed of yourselves

You spend more time watching ads than playing the game. After every level (basically every 1-2 minutes) you get a pop-up ad (of 30-60 seconds) no matter what, not even for extra coins or lives or anything... If the levels were longer maybe it wouldn't be so obvious that the game is only about the ad-money. Not worth downloading.

I really REALLY enjoyed this game, however, after like level 100 I kept getting ads after each level won. I kept playing regardless. Not only that, I made it up to level 674! But now, I have to undownload it because I've been charged 2x for something I didn't approve!!! This is ridiculous! I made it this far without purchases, I feel like the game is scamming me and my account because I made it so far without spending money. Sucks. I really liked this game too.

I'd give this 5 stars if it weren't for the purchase pop-ups, I just requested a refund from Google because an offer instantly pops up right where you're tapping if you lose a level and I accidentally purchased it. That's a scummy tactic, I think the ads after each level are reasonable, and I was considering buying the ad free pack but that won't take away the purchase pop up that appears right under my finger if I lose a level. So I just won't play anymore

was playing this daily. now it won't load. gets stuck on the load page. the only complaint I had when it was working was it left color blocks behind a lot. for example, you had 3 visible black blocks, goes around and only picks up one. has to go around a dozen times to pick up the other 2. but currently unplayable. I really like the game. please fix this.

The core gameplay is fun, BUT it has a predatory user interface design that tries to make you accidentally make in game purchases. When you're about to fail a stage, you're tapping furiously at the bottom of the screen to try to save yourself. Then when you actually fail, a $6 purchase immediately appears where you were tapping, almost guaranteeing that you buy it unintentionally. This game almost stole my money more times than I can count, so I'm uninstalling it before it succeeds.

it's a fun game, until you get stuck on a level. you cant go back and replay old levels to earn coins, and there is no daily reward system in place to earn coins. watching ads for coins is also not a feature in the game. it's a shame because the game itself is fun, the graphics are good, and it's very addicting. it's too bad the developers didn't provide an option that doesn't require spending actual money, especially since there's a forced ad between every level

This game drains your battery at lightning speed. I'm talking 18% to DEAD in less than 30 seconds. Not an exaggeration. I tested it a few times to be sure it wasn't just my phone. Also, when you are about to lose a level, you start tapping this one spot hoping to save it, and if it fails, the BUY button will pop up right where you were clicking, because they're hoping that you'll accidentally tap it. Thankfully, I don't have one click purchase on. If you do, stay far away from this game.

I actually like the concept of this game and find it fun but the levels repeat after a while so you end up playing the same levels over and over again, even though you're still progressing thru the level map. It makes the hard levels increasingly easy which is funny but also very annoying. Also the ads are a pain, they only show up (so far) after a level is completed, but it's basically after every single level.

As multiple people have stated in other reviews, the developers have added in predative strategies to get people to buy things. Upon failing a level, in the same exact location, you have to tap during the level, which is a purchase that goes through automatically with just 1 tap within less than 1 second of losing the level, no where near enough time to stop clicking. Sent them an email for a refund & am hoping they respond and change their predatory ways.

The game itself was fine until I received an unauthorized charge to my credit card for the game. they charged me $10 for in-game bundle. When the pop-up came up, I clicked X, received a Transacrion Canceled notification, but was still charged. I emailed their support, and all they told me was to dispute the charge with Google Play, but there was zero accountability.

game was fun to play for a while but, it is now impossible to play without paying for additional coins. I have no problem with ads in a game but, you don't even have the option to watch an ad to get extra coins. The worst part though is the amount of time I have accidentally almost made a purchase! It's happened over a dozen times now which tells me the placement of this purchase button is intentional and that's really scummy. I don't want that kind of app on my phone.

pretty good for a more consistent game play shooter game. ads are after every few levels, and not overly so. cons: the placement for coin purchases when you lose a level is honestly very inconveniently placed, because if you are spam clicking, you can accidentally pressure the purchase option if you lose suddenly. the levels start repeating at about level 300 or so, so it gets very repetitive.

there's an ad at the end of every single level. at a certain level it's impossible to pass without paying for extra special items. the pigs come in the same order on the level and they don't give you enough pigs to get to a key so you have to buy an "unlock". it is super mind numbing and awesome otherwise. also it's not like you can watch ads to earn the $ to buy items. and you can't just go back and play earlier levels.

Actually starting to enjoy the game. it's not a brain buster, but is still very satisfying to play. and yet, i cannot because the game keeps getting stuck on the loading screen, and reinstalling makes you have to start over from level 1. Even if short lived, it is worth experiencing. would rate higher if not for bug Trying to get me to rate way too early. So far it seems like pigs are unpredictable as to whether or not they will fire at a given cube. Doesn't give the vibe of a real puzzle game

This game kept showing up as an ad. I finally decided to download it, only to be disappointed very quickly. Once you get down to the last few pebbles the shooter cannot see them. It just keeps on going in circles indefinitely with no results. I tried quitting and going to another level with the same results. I even tried choosing the opposite color to end first, same results. Good concept, but it doesn't deliver. I wouldn't waste anymore time on this. If the glitch is fixed I MAY revisit.

As others have said, the UI is poorly designed when you fail a level. I don't have auto-purchase setup, so it's more a minor inconvenience for me. What really earns this a 1-star is the absolute battery drain this thing causes. I'm starting to wonder if there is something running within the code to crypto mine; my battery dropped from 15% to 5% in like 3 minutes while playing this. It's a decent time-killer, so I wish they'd actually address the chief complaints by everyone.

I really enjoy this game. It's fun to play when you need some mind numbing repetition. However, the insane amount of ads drives me up the wall. For the first 20ish levels you won't get any, then after that, after every single level (or if you fail to beat the level) you get an ad break. They are always infuriating and you have to hit the X on them 2 or 3 times before the ad actually closes. Sometimes it will open the app store and you haven't even touched anything.

High time commitment with extremely low reward. This game is really, really fun! But the ads are ridiculous. There is an ad about every 1-2 minutes. I would consider paying to be ad free, except there are other problems. Each completed level only earns 40 coins, but to pay for an extra life costs 900. That's 22 levels to earn enough fir 1 life! Also, it takes a really long time to earn lives. Rewards are way too low

This game doesn't have anything to make it stand out. It isn't even really a puzzle game, as you just click on the different colour pieces until you finish; it gets repetitive very quickly; you don't have to puzzle anything out - your brain stays offline, just click, click, click. On top of that, after the first 20 ad-free levels, there is an ad after EVERY SINGLE LEVEL. Not my idea of fun, uninstalling.

I like the game, but the ads made it really annoying to play after a while. You're forced to watch an ad between almost every level and most of them open up the Play store if you're using gestures instead of the back and home buttons. It also makes the option to watch an ad for double coins at the end of the round really moot. I have to watch the damned ad anyway, why even give the option?

Very addicting game, and I dont agree with what people say that you can't beat levels without using stuff, I got to level 500 without using a single one. What is a huge shame is that after a certain point levels just start repeating themselves. I kept playing hoping it's temporary and I'll eventually reach more original ones but nope. Made me instantly lose interest. The purchase button being so sneakily places is also quite eyebrow raising, thank god I dont have my cards set up.

Level 599!!! I love this game but am I the only one who can't beat level 599? Most of the color options aren't even colors on the board. It gives me white, yellow, royal blue, pink, black and turquoise as options but most of those aren't in the puzzle. No brown, red, gold, rose gold or light blue pigs as options and those colors are the majority of the puzzle. No walkthroughs or forums on it either. 😡

If anything interrupts you (a call, navigating over to a text message, etc.) the game is not capable of saving your place within a round/image and will start you all over when you reopen the app! Was considering if I liked it enough to pay for ads free for a minute, and in the end I'm so frustrated I'm deleting it instead. I can't sign on for a game where a round can take 15 minutes, and you'll be near the end, and an unexpected phone call ruins progress and wastes power ups.

The game itself is fun, but the ads they show are often manipulative or broken (ex. clicking "close" opens the play store, ex. the ad crashes the game), the "ad free upgrade" is expensive, and it can't be played offline. Too many ticks in the "predatory game patterns" column for me. Ugh, I'm upset because I like this game enough to pay for it. But if I'm paying $8, it should be because the game is fun, not because I can't stand the ads. It feels icky.

The game itself is fun, the easy relaxing levels, but the very hard levels will force you to spend money. They add new things every 3 levels or so to make it impossible to beat, as many others have said. DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME WITH THIS GAME. Not at all what I thought it would be. Between the ads, the UI, and the levels that just get harder and harder, it's not worth it. The further you get, the less easy levels there are.

The only thing going for the app is it was exactly as described in the ad(s) I saw, which can be rare. You can play about 20 stages before the true purpose of this app rears its head: ad farm. Started the second I finished stage 19 and every single move I made in game moving forward was met with an ad. Beat a level? Here's an ad. Use a booster? Here's an ad. Navigate within the game? Have another ad. No thanks. I'd give 0 if that were an option.

I did 65 levels. Game is fine in the beginning, but lacks any challenge at all once you learn it. Elements which are added at higher levels (like linked blocks, locks etc) make game actually more stupid and easy, because they limit your options. Ads after every level (once you get to L10 or so) are annoying. If you want a good looking mindless time waster, give it a try.

I have given this game a really good run. for the amount of ads you watch ( not a big problem I'm just talking about value added ). they should be feeding players items to keep the engaged. Some levels are nearly impossible without something. This game isn't a game you spend money on. It's a pass the time by game. I'm moving on now but it was fun for a bit.

I like the game, but I hate the whole thing of a maximum of 5 "lives", and to get a new life it takes 30 minutes, purchasing more or watching ads. Forget it. I imagine I can find other similar games that don't have this restriction. It just annoys me when playing difficult levels and losing all lives. So you lost me after just a little over a week.

its a fun game. but being forced to watch an ad in between every round is on the nose. even worse that some advertising is erotica and not suitable for minors. im not a prude, but i must have missed the part where you had to be 18+ to play. there is also no way to gain coin or boosts other than advancing through levels or spending. so I will be deleting the app and moving on very soon. it was fun for a week or so.

Extremely frustrating the further in you get and levels are designed in such a way that you absolutely CAN NOT win unless you use a power up. Worse so is that if you fail the level it doesn't give you an option to keep going for a cost of in game currency like most other puzzle games, meaning you will have effectively wasted whatever little power ups you had. Very far from relaxing and how you have to cheese the levels or spend money, I wouldn't say it's a "puzzle" game either.

Gonna be totally honest, I've been playing the game for a while. I enjoy the game and all of the designs. My issue has been that I've made it to a point (lvl 700+) where the levels have become so big that it is causing the shooters to lag and sometimes skip over certain pegs. often making it impossible for me to get the keys necessary to beat the levels. I have done everything I can on my phone to make the game run better. hoping this review will help developers know about the issue.

I was really enjoying this game, then got stuck at level 279 and the keys would not unlock. Looked at several online tutorial videos and my level was not responding the same. I even purchased additional coins to use the extra tools and still could not get through it. I uninstalled after this. Side note, the ads are excessive and take away another star. I understand thats how the app developers make money but the game would be far more enjoyable and $8 for ad free is too steep for a phone game.

For centuries to come, the game is fun. And enjoyable, except that you're forced to watch an ad after every level. In some levels, only take 20 or 30 seconds. And I never leave reviews, but this game ticked me off, we'd have to have an internet connection even though it will play without one. But there's a window that pops up saying that internet connection is required. Even though the game is running in the background. SOOOO STUPIDLY CODED!

I am going to address an issue I have not seen anyone else in the reviews mention. HEATING! Whatever the hell resources this game uses is way too much, after 1 level the back of my phone is hot to the touch! None of my other games do this and I can play them for hours, even on charge and no hot phone. Otherwise I enjoy the game a lot, in the 400s level wise, I don't mind getting an ad after every level, as there is no ads during a level.

I'm level 258 and haven't bought a thing. Sometimes I have to try a level multiple times before I figure out how to beat it but I don't mind that. The free boosts you get every once in awhile can help some too. The only thing I wish they'd change is the amount of coin you get for beating a level. It would be nice if it would go up along with the price of items or the extra tray row. Otherwise I've really enjoyed this game.

Ad City!!! This is an app for ads, with some fun peppered in. I can't get through 1 level without an ad popping up after. I suffered as long as I could, because it was an interesting puzzle game, but my good god! I'll be keeping an eye out for any game done by this publisher, just so I know never to download it!!!!!

installed to say one thing. your ads are AWFUL. the playable ads you poured money into making "playable" are oversized download buttons. what's the point in even having them if i have to close out of the app store 45 times just to get through the game preview on your ad? i might actually play it if it weren't so infuriating to even be introduced to. do better, because this is terrible.

Somewhere between level 40 and 45, this game presents a puzzle that is unsolvable unless you buy power ups from them. Keys are locked behind bricks that you do not have the colors to access without buying them. I've played this level down to the point where I have a row of locks on top and no other colors. I will pay money for a game I enjoy. I will not pay to play. One star.

Way too many ads, all of them being sixty second ads that you cannot skip or mute. Even after the ad is over, you have to wait for it to download the playable Ad...so you can exit. Which then takes you to the play store that you have to back out of to finally close the ad on the 3rd attempt. Firmly against having to leave the same ad three separate occasions. That's after waiting for sixty seconds for it to finish. There is making money then there's this

The fact that this game is SO GOOD but the fact you cannot play it offline is CRIMINAL. I click on the 40 coins to avoid ads after finishing a level AND STILL GET AN AD. I wish I could support this app in good conscience but I cannot! it's ridiculous to have to watch unstoppable ads for the 80 coins and the ads running 2-3 minutes long, if not longer. Give us an offline play option!

Overall a fun game and I would recommend this game for casual play. HOWEVER there are levels generally the very hard ones that are 100% designed to be unbeatable without power ups and if you don't have any and are unwilling to pay around $10+ each tome, then you're stuck. I am very much considering uninstalling the game and calling it a lost cause. NOT WORTH IT, if you intend to play this game indepth for a long time.

Update: After the latest update the game freezes at the loading screen so you can't play at all. It's very entertaining until you get to impossible levels. They should make it so the game progress doesn't disappear when you lose wifi or have to put your phone to sleep for a few minutes. I would never pay to play, so I guess I'll have to delete it if they don't fix the app.

Most of the pictures/levels are gorgous - I'll even accept the Rick Roll level. The game is quite addictive but level 299 seems impossible without using the power-ups and coins - all the levels up to this point have been possible without needing power-ups or coins. Ads after every level is way too much and ad-free price is not worth it - if the number of ads is reduced, I would be willing to give more stars.

Was working just fine, really enjoyed the game. But it hasn't worked since the last 2 updates. it says it's loading, but never actually does. I've tried everything except uninstalling. I did that last time I had this issue, and while it did fix the glitch it also erased all my progress. Hoping they release an update that actually fixes it.

Good & Relaxing This is a simplistic puzzle game with no time limits. It's a step up from mindless, so perfect for relaxing and zoning out while listening to a book or podcast. There were hardly any ads, which was fantastic. The few there were, could all be skipped in about 5-10 seconds.
